notes.title: Update 30/12/2024: New Area, Steam Achievement, and Performance Boost!
notes.notes:
Discover the Shadows: Update 30/12/2024

This update brings exciting new content and enhancements to deepen your descent into the shadows. Here’s what’s waiting for you:


 🗺️ New Map Area: Explore an extended section of the hospital, uncovering eerie details and hidden secrets.
 🧩 A New Puzzle: Challenge your wits with a fresh puzzle that ties directly into the unfolding story.
 📖 Expanded Storyline: Learn more about the dark history of the hospital and the chilling events that brought it to life.
 🚪 A Unique Room: Discover a room unlike any other in the game—mysterious, unsettling, and full of intrigue.
 🏆 Steam Achievement: Unlock a brand-new achievement as you progress through the new content.
 💡 Lighting Enhancements: Improved lighting for a more immersive and atmospheric experience.
 🚀 Performance Optimization: Enjoy smoother gameplay with enhanced performance and reduced loading times.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Dive back into the shadows, uncover the mysteries, and brace yourself for what lies ahead! 🌑👻

Don't forget the discord here : https://discord.gg/7GuRfGSjGM
